meta.title: Global rules editor
meta.description: Open Global rules in the left sidebar, below Plugins and Automations, to edit DSH's user-global AGENTS.md and any project rules file in a workspace; nested AGENTS.md files are listed beside the root one, and New creates one under a subdirectory. Saves are atomic and refuse to clobber a file changed after loading, and the Host resolves every path so the page cannot address arbitrary files. Changes apply to new sessions.
